duplicateHint: Copy it into your global folder, for every project

memoryMissing: This file doesn't exist yet: saving creates it.
conflict: The file changed on disk since it was opened.
discardMessage: This file has unsaved changes. They will be lost.

Removes the link {path}.

materialize.openHint: Turn every link into Puppeteer's old library (HOME and every project) into a file of its own. You see the list first.
materialize.title: Turn links into files
materialize.intro:
Skills, rules, commands and agents Puppeteer linked from its old library are shared: editing one changes it in every project linked to it.
Each link below becomes a copy of its own, with the same content. Puppeteer's blocks in a project's AGENTS.md keep their text and lose only their markers. Nothing else is touched.
materialize.nothing: Nothing to change: no link into Puppeteer's old library is left.
materialize.inGitWarning: {count} of these are tracked by git: the change shows up in the repo and goes into your next commit.
materialize.failed: Stopped at {path}: {error}. What was converted before it stays converted.
materialize.libraryKept: The old library stays as it is. Each change is logged.

tabNoMatch: No {kind} matches “{query}”. Search only filters inside the selected tab.
globalNoMemory: Global has no Memory tab: global memory is edited in Settings › AI › Memory.
newNameInvalid: Use a plain name: no / or \, no .., and not starting with a dot.
newExists: A {kind} with this name already exists.

sourceHint.project: From the project's .claude/settings.json, shared through git
sourceHint.local: From the project's .claude/settings.local.json, on this machine only
sourceHint.installed: From ~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json: no settings file read here sets it

config.readOnly: Read-only: Puppeteer shows what the file declares and changes nothing. Edit the file, or use /hooks and /plugin in Claude Code.
config.allDisabled: This file sets disableAllHooks to true: hooks are turned off.

stateHint.on: Turned on by enabledPlugins in the file above
stateHint.off: Turned off by enabledPlugins in the file above
stateHint.unset: No settings file read here turns it on or off

config.mcpNote: Listed only: MCP servers are switched on and off under MCP.
config.customPaths: plugin.json also points to other paths for: {keys}. Parts there are not listed.
